description: On apply wizard step 2 (Questions), the cookie-consent banner ("We use cookies for sign-in, saved jobs and analytics... Got it") renders as a floating overlay directly on top of a required radio-button question ("This role asks for 5+ years — do you meet that? Yes / Close to it"), partially covering the Yes option. The Review application button stays disabled until that hidden question is answered, so a seeker who has not yet dismissed the cookie banner may be unable to see or click the required option, silently blocking progress through the apply wizard.
repro: Login, apply to a job whose step-2 Questions include a Yes/Close-to-it style radio question, do not pre-dismiss cookies; observe the banner overlapping the radio buttons
fix_hint: Anchor the cookie banner so it never overlaps in-flow form controls (e.g. fixed to very bottom with page padding-bottom reserved, or move above the fold as a slim top bar), and/or persist the dismissal so it does not reappear per page

description: The cookie-consent banner ("Got it"/"Compris") reappears on page after page (seen on job-detail, apply step 2, etc.) rather than staying dismissed for the session after the first "Got it" click.

fix_hint: Persist cookie-consent acknowledgement (localStorage flag is fine here per site policy) so the banner shows once, not on every route change
